title: Capability-first composition: contract and first positive path
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: capability-composition in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Bind one host command to a real owned or external provider through the least-cost valid boundary, with no peer-UI mount. Record provider/consumer contracts, shared object identity and before/after behavior.
negative_acceptance: A host command uses a real provider with zero UI mounts and retains a coherent result.
A proposed handroll without owned/external alternatives or consumer impact remains incomplete.
A faster or shorter replacement that breaks a critical consumer is rejected.
A valid in-process provider is not forced through an unnecessary network layer.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Capability-first composition: negative controls and qualified consumer
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: capability-composition in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Run the same contract with the provider absent, failed, revoked and replaced; add a second compatible consumer and prove one authoritative result with no duplicate mutation or data copy.
negative_acceptance: A prohibited UI/transport dependency introduced into the domain fails the architecture check.
Revoked authority or absent optional peer does not silently trigger privileged fallback.
Two host perspectives reference one authoritative object and reject duplicate mutation.
Mocked provider success cannot satisfy a required live integration.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Agent bridge and graphical proof: contract and first positive path
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: agent-bridge in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Adapt one existing white-box or permitted gray-box bridge. Bind the actual candidate, process, window and nonce; correlate user action, application effect and final-frame capture without fixture shortcuts.
negative_acceptance: An unavailable proprietary-state API cannot be marked exercised.
A wrong process or stale nonce is rejected before input.
Teleport/state mutation cannot satisfy a click-and-move user-path criterion.
Acknowledgement without the required effect is non-accepting.
A prior frame from the correct window cannot prove a new action.
Cross-worker capture/data access or missing license cannot be bypassed to pass.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Agent bridge and graphical proof: negative controls and qualified consumer
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: agent-bridge in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Exercise one owned-game witness and one permitted host-game witness with known-bad input/render controls, fine ROIs and temporal samples. Demonstrate stale-window/frame rejection and isolate foreground resources.
negative_acceptance: A logic-only run is rejected for a required graphical claim.
Timeout is not successful completion and uncertain side effects are reconciled before retry.
A missing small required icon fails even if full-frame similarity is high.
A lucky still frame cannot satisfy a temporal criterion.
Disabling the effect under test cannot produce shipping-quality approval.
Known-bad subtle examples must be caught at the predeclared required rates.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Canonical design and complete artifact traceability: contract and first positive path
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: design-traceability in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Canonicalize one editable UI/flow or scene design with populated/empty/error/recovery states and fixture data. Keep proposals and approval evidence separate; link the actual implementation and capture.
negative_acceptance: A runtime screenshot cannot replace the missing editable design when required.
One happy-path frame cannot close an entire flow.
An agent-written approved field without actual decision evidence does not promote scope.
Autoupdating a failed screenshot baseline without a decision cannot close the defect.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Canonical design and complete artifact traceability: negative controls and qualified consumer
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: design-traceability in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Run forward and reverse gap checks across intent, contracts, assets, code, configuration, tests, runs and installed artifact. Change one design/source element and prove affected evidence becomes stale without losing history.
negative_acceptance: Excluded code or generated files do not disappear from the inventory without producer/scope rationale.
A complete forward link set does not conceal an unowned public command.
A generated page does not fabricate an AgilePlus engine transition or authoritative data move.
Dropping a hard requirement to improve the percentage is visible and needs authorization.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Evidence-bound numeric product grading: contract and first positive path
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: machine-grading in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Bind the existing rubric owner to one frozen scope/profile. Adapt native evidence into typed scored obligations, compute category weights and a literal percentage/letter, and display missing weight and mandatory gates.
negative_acceptance: The output names scope/profile/revision and never presents the result as universal quality.
Adding many easy tests or duplicate criteria cannot silently dilute a failed critical criterion.
Stale, wrong-build or no-pixel evidence earns no credit for a visible current feature.
Deleting missing outcomes from the evidence set cannot increase the grade.
A high numeric grade with a failed critical invariant remains BLOCKED.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
permission_prerequisites: Actual owner and unique worktree/path lease

title: Evidence-bound numeric product grading: negative controls and qualified consumer
owner_role: Existing subject/shared owner; one integration lead
logical_write_scope: machine-grading in accepted owner repository; bind actual paths before mutation
outcome: Adversarially test grade dilution, stale/wrong-build receipts, missing media, synthetic/live mismatch and failing critical checks. Compare the computed grade with independently inspected outcomes and qualify actual producer/oracle boundaries.
negative_acceptance: Model confidence is not accepted as a probability or proof.
A scope expansion is not misreported as a code regression or hidden to keep a score rising.
A structurally valid invented receipt never claims authenticated product qualification.
Do not assert line coverage of inaccessible third-party engine internals.
No invented acronym or new registry becomes authority from this amendment.
rollback: Retain original source/design/evidence and use scoped rollback; no lifecycle or destructive authority granted.
